description: Stat card: a title plus big numbers (grid) or a two-column list, with an optional photo on the left. For player lines, team scorers, injuries, standings, recaps, schedules.

fields.title: Main title, e.g. a player name. *word* = accent color
fields.tag: Small label above the title, e.g. MIAMI HEAT
fields.rows: Items separated by ; and each item is value|label. Grid: 31|PTS;18|REB. List: Haliburton|Hamstring, out 2+ weeks
fields.layout: grid (default: big numbers) or list (rows of left | right)
fields.photo: Optional photo, shown on the left 45% of the frame
fields.photo_pos: Which part of the photo to keep, CSS object-position (default center), e.g. 30% 20%
fields.color: Team color for the stripe and accents (hex, default brand accent)
fields.footer: Optional small line at the bottom, e.g. a source
